title: Polynomially indexed verifier projection and logarithmic suffix search
claims: IndexedWitnessProjection establishes deterministic polynomial-time decision for a verifier applied to polynomially clocked, uniformly generated candidates.
LogarithmicSuffixWitnesses establishes deterministic polynomial-time decision under explicit suffix coverage and verification soundness premises.
IndexedVerifierCollapse establishes the conditional implication from general polynomially indexed witness coverage to equality of the pinned P and NP classes.
P_subset_NP checks the unchanged reference inclusion.
